title.zh: CFTC chair pushes tokenization as SEC opens door to onchain stocks
title.en: CFTC chair pushes tokenization as SEC opens door to onchain stocks

current_state.zh: CFTC Chair Michael Selig told the US Treasury Market Conference that financial markets should prepare for 'mass tokenization' of real-world assets with near-instant settlement, as the SEC simultaneously moves toward permitting onchain stocks despite the CLARITY Act setback.
